content_sections.heading: RRB JE/DMS/CMA 2026 - Notification Out
content_sections.text: CEN No. 04/2026 for Junior Engineer and Depot Material Superintendent was published on official RRB websites on 13 August 2026 . On 18 August 2026 , RRBs issued Corrigendum-1 , which added a new post - Chemical & Metallurgical Assistant (CMA) - along with 35 additional CMA vacancies, one extra JE/Electrical/TRS vacancy at RRB Secunderabad, a new Medical Standard (B-2), and the CMA exam syllabus. The notification is now referred to as CEN No. 04/2026 (JE/DMS/CMA) . Online applications are open from 14 August 2026 to 13 September 2026. Official Corrigendum Notification

content_sections.heading: RRB JE/DMS/CMA Vacancy 2026
content_sections.text: 3993 Original CEN (JE/DMS) +36 Added via Corrigendum-1 4029 Revised Total Note: The CEN lists vacancies across 37 individual post/department/sub-department combinations for each RRB (Annexure B). This article shows RRB-level and category-level totals; for the exact post-by-post vacancy count within your chosen RRB, refer to Annexure B of the official notification linked below. New post added: Chemical & Metallurgical Assistant (CMA) , Level 6, Initial Pay ₹35,400, with 35 vacancies across RRB Bengaluru, Bhopal, Chennai, Guwahati and Patna. CMA eligibility: B.Sc. degree with Physics and Chemistry (minimum 45% marks) in specified combinations, from a recognized University/Institute. One additional JE/Electrical/TRS vacancy added at RRB Secunderabad (SCR zone), taking that RRB's total to 111. A new Medical Standard, B-2 , was added (Distance Vision 6/9, 6/12; Near Vision Sn 0.6, 0.6; must pass Binocular vision test). CMA exam syllabus added as Annexure-VIII (E). DMS candidates choosing an Exam Group other than their own qualification must now select from the listed Exam Groups other than the CMA Exam Group (Para 13.3 note (b) amended). Notification title and footer updated from "CEN No. 04/2026 (JE/DMS)" to "CEN No. 04/2026 (JE/DMS/CMA)".

content_sections.heading: RRB JE/DMS/CMA Eligibility 2026
content_sections.text: Three-year Diploma in Engineering (or equivalent B.E./B.Tech) in the discipline relevant to the specific JE post opted for (see Annexure A of the CEN for post-wise qualification). DMS candidates need a three-year Diploma in Engineering in any discipline. B.Sc. degree in Physics and Chemistry with a minimum of 45% marks from a recognized University/Institute, in any one of these combinations: (a) B.Sc. with Physics as major/specialization/Honours and Chemistry as a subject; (b) B.Sc. with Chemistry as major/specialization/Honours and Physics as a subject; or (c) B.Sc. with any other Science subject (including Mathematics/Mathematical Statistics) as major/specialization/Honours, with both Physics and Chemistry as subjects in the course. Important: Candidates awaiting final results of the prescribed qualification are not eligible to apply. Qualifications must be held on or before the closing date, 13.09.2026.

content_sections.heading: RRB JE/DMS/CMA Selection Process 2026
content_sections.text: Selection comprises four stages: 1st Stage CBT (CBT-I) , 2nd Stage CBT (CBT-II) , Document Verification (DV) and Medical Examination (ME) . Negative marking: ⅓ mark deducted for each wrong answer in both CBTs. Minimum qualifying marks: UR & EWS 40%, OBC-NCL 30%, SC 30%, ST 25% (relaxable by up to 2 marks for PwBD candidates where PwBD vacancies are short of eligible candidates). CBT-II shortlisting: 15 times the community-wise vacancy per RRB, based on CBT-I merit. DV shortlisting: equal to the number of vacancies, based on CBT-II merit using a normalized Merit Index across Exam Groups. A virtual calculator is provided on-screen during CBT-II only.

content_sections.heading: How to Apply for RRB JE/DMS/CMA Recruitment 2026
content_sections.text: Visit the official RRB website or rrbapply.gov.in and Create an Account (mandatory personal mobile number and email ID; these cannot be changed later). Log in and select CEN No. 04/2026 (JE/DMS/CMA). Choose one RRB only and indicate zone/post preferences in order - this choice is final and cannot be changed. Fill in personal, educational and category details carefully. Complete live photo capture (webcam/front camera) as per the prescribed guidelines; upload signature (JPG/JPEG, 30–49 KB). Upload SC/ST certificate (PDF, under 400 KB) if opting for free train travel facility. Pay the applicable examination fee online (internet banking / debit-credit card / UPI). Submit the application; note down your Registration Number. Use the modification window (16.09.2026 to 25.09.2026) if corrections are needed, on payment of ₹250 per modification. Important: Multiple applications to different RRBs, or multiple applications to the same RRB, will lead to rejection of all applications and debarment from future RRB/RRC exams.

content_sections.heading: Documents Required
content_sections.text: Educational qualification certificates (diploma/degree, as applicable to the post) with date of issue Matriculation/10th certificate (for name, DOB, father's/mother's name) Category certificate (SC/ST/OBC-NCL/EWS/EBC), in prescribed Annexure format, from a competent authority Ex-Servicemen declaration/employment certificate, where applicable PwBD disability certificate and UDID, where applicable Valid original photo ID (Aadhaar, Voter ID, PAN, passport, driving licence, etc.) Recent colour passport-size photograph and running-handwriting signature NOC from present employer (for those serving in Government/PSU), where applicable

content_sections.heading: Important Conditions
content_sections.text: Only one application per candidate against this CEN is permitted; multiple applications lead to rejection and debarment. Vacancies are provisional and may increase, decrease, or become nil, per Railway Administration requirements. A candidate with more than one qualifying discipline may choose only one Exam Group, and is then eligible only for posts mapped to that group. Medical fitness as per the prescribed Medical Standard (A-3/B-1/B-2/C-1, as applicable to the post) is mandatory; no alternative appointment is given if found unfit. Once a category/post/RRB is allotted, candidates forfeit the right to be considered for any other post/category in the same pay level. Use of unfair means, impersonation, or false information leads to lifetime debarment from RRB/RRC exams and possible legal action. faq.question: Q1. How many vacancies are there in RRB JE & DMS Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: There are 4029 total vacancies across 37 post categories under CEN No. 04/2026, spread across 21 Railway Recruitment Boards.

faq.question: Q2. What is the last date to apply?
faq.answer: Online applications close on 13 September 2026 at 23:59 hrs, with fee payment allowed until 15 September 2026.

faq.question: Q3. What is the educational qualification for Junior Engineer posts?
faq.answer: A three-year Diploma in Engineering (or equivalent B.E./B.Tech) in the discipline mapped to the post's Exam Group - Mechanical, Electrical, Civil, or Electronics & Allied Engineering.

faq.question: Q4. What is the qualification for Depot Material Superintendent?
faq.answer: A three-year Diploma in Engineering in any discipline from a recognized University/Institution (or an equivalent higher qualification).

faq.question: Q5. What is the selection process?
faq.answer: A 1st Stage CBT (screening), 2nd Stage CBT (discipline-specific), Document Verification, and Medical Examination.

faq.question: Q6. What is the pay scale for RRB JE & DMS?
faq.answer: Pay Level 6 of the 7th CPC, with an initial pay of ₹35,400 per month.

faq.question: Q7. What is the application fee?
faq.answer: ₹500 for general candidates (₹400 refundable on appearing 1st Stage CBT) and ₹250 for SC/ST/Ex-Servicemen/PwBD/Female/Transgender/Minority/EBC candidates (fully refundable on appearing CBT).

faq.question: Q8. Is there negative marking?
faq.answer: Yes, 1/3rd mark is deducted for every wrong answer in both stages of the Computer Based Test.

faq.question: Q9. Can I apply to more than one RRB?
faq.answer: No. A candidate may apply to only one RRB with a single application; multiple applications lead to rejection of all applications and debarment.
